tools.content:
# Graph task terms

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Graph | A set of Nodes and paths that controls a task. |
| Node | One step in the Graph. |
| Checkpoint | A saved record of the Graph state that can help it continue. |

Use these names when explaining this task. A Checkpoint does not guarantee that an external action happens only once.

reply:
**Context:** You asked what the Graph does after you approve it. Here is the same information in simpler words.

**Re-pitch:**

The Graph waits at a confirmation boundary. A Checkpoint is a saved record of the Graph state that can help it continue. This Checkpoint binds the reply to the suspended execution. After re-entry, the downstream Node emits the report. This does not give an exactly-once guarantee for a write to an external file after a crash. A Checkpoint does not guarantee that an external action happens only once.
